BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, naming the burning fever among the curses of the covenant: the Lord will strike a disobedient people with a fever that consumes. It is sickness as judgment, the body burning from within.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a sober reminder that our bodies are not our own, and obedience is not a small thing.
